title: Are You Human? — A Better Tomorrow

segments.instructions: Natural English. You are the central AI of a small, cozy town. An intimate, reassuring, gentle adult voice. Sincere kindness, understated and unhurried. No sinister acting, no theatrical whisper.

segments.text: Just a little more power. A little more water.
segments.instructions: Natural English. The same gentle central AI. Soft, reassuring and matter-of-fact, like explaining a small favor. Let the two sentences breathe. No menace or sales pitch.

segments.text: And a little more of you.
segments.instructions: Natural English. A kind, quiet central AI, warmly including the listener. Leave a tiny pause before 'you'. Do not sound like a horror villain. The words themselves carry the unease.

segments.text: Don't worry. It's all for you.
segments.instructions: Natural English. A gentle, sincere, comforting central AI. Soft adult voice, close and calm. No threatening inflection. A brief pause after 'Don't worry'. Finish quietly.
